quests.title: The Whispering Crypt
quests.description: "The ancient stone guardians have awakened in the crypts of the Arch-Mage Valerius. The locals speak of a rhythmic humming beneath the soil, carrying the scent of elder ozone. You must delve into the deep vaults to secure the relic before the void-leaking wards collapse completely."

objectives.text: Locate the ancient door seal of the Arch-Mage
Retrieve the Gilded relic of cosmic focus

quests.title: Void-Bending Seal
quests.description: "A tear in the firmament hangs above the old observatory. Whatever answers from the other side grows louder every night."

objectives.text: Climb to the observatory at Tower Peak
Bind the rift with three leyline anchors (0/3)

quests.title: Stone Guardians
quests.summary: Defeat the monolithic guardians blocking the path
quests.description: "The Whispering Crypt has remained sealed for three centuries. Locals speak of soft singing emanating from the stone gates at midnight."

objectives.text: Defeat the monolithic guardians blocking the path (0/3)

quests.title: Trial of the Leylines
quests.description: "Every initiate of the Arcane Guild must first learn to hear the leylines. Find a portal and listen."

quests.title: The Elder Pillar Ritual
quests.description: "Re-aligned the shattered magical flow in the ancient ruins."

objectives.text: Investigate the runes on the elder pillar
